title: Prove rank-1 deletions maximize the power-sum drop
body:
## Summary
- At `a = 1/596`, a rank-1 step changes the power sum by exactly 1. For every rank from 2 through 73, one step changes it by strictly less than 1, because `z^595 < z^596` for `z = r/(r-1)`.
- When the combined power sum is strictly larger than the forward sum, the second-derivative bracket in the pair count is bounded below by `U(16p + 16ap + 2 + 16a)`, which is positive for every integer `p ≥ 1`. The same bound holds at the selected kappa.
- Partial result. The signed excess enclosure is left in the published receipt. No new kappa and no selected-frontier change.
